## Outcome
What changed for the player/system?

## Scope
What was intentionally not changed?

## Risk
Low / Medium / High / Critical

## Verification
- [ ] focused deterministic checks
- [ ] build/typecheck/tests where relevant
- [ ] runtime QA where user-facing
- [ ] desktop/mobile where relevant
- [ ] save/load where relevant
- [ ] SDK/ads/analytics where relevant
- [ ] independent review for medium/high/critical work

## Evidence
Links to screenshots, video, logs, reports or CI artifacts.

## Rollback
How can this change be safely reverted?

## Documentation
What source-of-truth docs/Skills/guardrails were updated?
